def stop_free(s):
    stops={"TAA","TAG","TGA"}
    best=[]
    for frame in range(3):
        i=frame
        runs=[]
        cur_start=i
        j=frame
        while j<len(s)-2:
            if s[j:j+3] in stops:
                runs.append((cur_start,j))
                cur_start=j+3
            j+=3
        runs.append((cur_start,min(len(s),j)))
        for a,b in runs:
            best.append((b-a,frame,a,b))
    best.sort(reverse=True)
    return best
